arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/apispec/ext/marshmallow/common.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('apispec.ext.marshmallow.common')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
from marshmallow import fields
from apispec.ext.marshmallow.common import filter_excluded_fields
class Meta:
 exclude=['hidden']
 dump_only=['meta_output']
values={'visible':fields.String(),'hidden':fields.String(),'output':fields.String(dump_only=True),'meta_output':fields.String()}
all_fields=filter_excluded_fields(values,Meta,exclude_dump_only=False)
input_fields=filter_excluded_fields(values,Meta,exclude_dump_only=True)
print('filtered_field_names',list(all_fields),list(input_fields))
assert set(all_fields)=={'visible','output','meta_output'}
assert set(input_fields)=={'visible'}
